title: CircuitBreakerEscalation
description: Strict JSON schema for escalating tasks back to the GM when loops fail to converge.

escalation_reason.description: Reason for breaking the loop and escalating.

loop_count.description: Number of iterations attempted before escalation.

failed_files.description: List of files that are failing validation.

gm_action_required.description: Request or context for the GM to resolve the blocker.
